text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a regional traffic handover from EU -> APAC tonight, target start 21:00 UTC. This is a gradual 25% -> 50% -> 100% ramp over ~45m. Who can own the deploy window?
Priya: I can take primary deploy owner for the 21:00 window. Will be oncall from 20:45-22:15.
Sam: I’ll be in the channel for infra / routing policy changes and rollback.
Maya: I’ll run smoke checks and monitor SLOs during the ramp.
Alex: Thanks. Quick checklist I put together: preflight, deploy steps, smoke checks, rollback. Sharing details below.
Priya: drop them pls so I can ack and run through preflight.
Alex: Preflight: 1) Ensure region-policy-v2 exists and targets apac-backends health=healthy
2) DNS TTL for api.redwood.ai set to 60s for the window
3) Edge LB health probes green in APAC
4) Canary routing rule enabled for 10% for first 10m
Sam: Confirmed: `region-policy-v2` present in control plane, last change 3 days ago. LB probes returning 200 from apac-probe nodes.
Sam: DNS change is manual via terraform workspace `tf-prod-dns`. I’ll queue a plan now and share apply ETA.
Alex: Good. Smoke checks (Maya): basic flow — create test session, generate text 512 tokens, embed call, and token billing sanity.
Maya: My smoke checklist: 
- POST /v1/chat with test prompt -> <300ms p95 for APAC route
- Embedding batch of 8 -> no error spikes
- Token accounting compare to baseline
- Logs: no surge of `KV cache miss` errors
I’ll paste results as I go.
Priya: One note: rate limiter bucket sizes differ per region; I’ll temporarily relax quota if we see 429s during ramp.
Alex: Rollback plan: revert route policy to `region-policy-stable` and restore DNS TTL to 600s. Rollback command for control plane: 
```
redwoodctl routing set --policy region-policy-stable --target eu
```
Priya: A couple of ops notes:
- We’ll do a 10m wait at each step (25%, 50%, 100%) and run Maya’s smoke checklist after each pause.
- If any p95 latency regresses >20% or error rate >0.5% absolute, rollback immediately.
Sam: Terraform apply for DNS will be at :50 of the hour to align with canary start. I’ll post the plan id here once created.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window for `region-policy-v2` at 21:00 UTC (25% -> 50% -> 100%) via rollout plan id rp-20260317-7.
Priya: Ack rp-20260317-7. I’ll start the deploy and ping again on each step.
Maya: Also will watch the following dashboards: `infra/edge/latency`, `api/errors`, `billing/token-usage`. Posting links: https://grafana.redwood/edge-latency https://grafana.redwood/api-errors
Alex: Reminder: no DB schema changes, just routing. Cache TTL on edge is 60s so small risk.
Sam: Plan ID for DNS apply: tf-plan-88b4. Applying at 20:50 UTC, ETA ~2m. I’ll annotate the change in the plan with `apac-ttl-60` tag.
Priya: Pre-deploy PPE: `curl -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://edge-proxy.apac/test -> 200, latency 120ms` done.
Maya: First smoke (25%): POST chat test -> 250ms p95, embeddings ok, no errors. All green.
Priya: Moving to 50% now.
Maya: Second smoke (50%): p95 280ms, error rate 0.03% — within threshold.
Alex: If all green after 10m, do final 100% shift.
Priya: 100% complete. DNS TTL restored to 60 for the window.
Maya: Final smoke: p95 300ms, small token accounting drift +1.2% (expected). No KV cache spikes.
Sam: Post-deploy checks: background batch jobs OK, storage latency unchanged.
Priya: Closing deploy — leaving `region-policy-v2` as active. Will open a follow-up doc with metrics and notes.
Alex: Thanks everyone. If anything odd emerges overnight, tag SRE-Oncall and we’ll roll back. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Noted: rollout rp-20260317-7 completed by Priya at 21:45 UTC. Metrics snapshot saved to s3://redwood-rollouts/20260317/rp-20260317-7.json
Maya: I’ll chase a brief postmortem style summary in #eng-postmortems tomorrow with the key dashboards and a note on the +1.2% token drift.
Priya: Great job all. :tada:
